# ScribeCat 0.25.1

## Fixes
- Correctly route PDF, DOCX, PPTX and video attachments to their dedicated viewers.
- Remove the mouse grab/grabbing behavior from zoomed PDFs while keeping touch panning.
- Preserve pointer-anchored PDF pinch and trackpad zoom and native text selection.
- Rebuild the desktop artifacts from the corrected 0.25.1 tag.
